title.en: Operator view — attention kernels and SSM Green's functions
title.zh: 算子视角——注意力核与 SSM 格林函数

en.a: Attention is a data-dependent kernel integral operator; an LTI SSM is a causal Green's-function operator; their finite sequence matrices occupy different structure classes.
en.b: Both still map a prefix to a next-token distribution. The operator view changes the mathematical object used to describe the prefix interaction, not the autoregressive interface.

zh.a: 注意力是一个数据依赖的核积分算子；线性时不变（LTI）状态空间模型（SSM）是一个因果格林函数算子；它们的有限序列矩阵占据不同的结构类。
zh.b: 两者仍将前缀映射到下一个 token 的分布。算子视角改变了用于描述前缀交互的数学对象，而非自回归接口。
